adjudication.rationale: Looking at the diff for deleteEvent around line 312-317, the code sets calendarId using a conditional that checks `externalCalendarId ? externalCalendarId : event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId`. This logic is flawed - when externalCalendarId is falsy, the find condition `cal.externalId === externalCalendarId` will never match (comparing to undefined/null), so it returns undefined. Then line 318 uses `calendarId || defaultCalendarId` which falls back to 'primary'. This means if no externalCalendarId is provided, the deletion will target 'primary' calendar instead of the actual destination calendar, potentially leaving the real event orphaned. The finding correctly identifies this as a bug.
